name: NASA Technical Standard 6016C — Standard Materials and Processes Requirements for Spacecraft
description: Standard materials and processes requirements applicable to spacecraft hardware manufacture and assembly.

rules.title: Approved material list
rules.text: Materials used in flight hardware shall be drawn from the program-approved materials list; substitutions require engineering approval and reconciliation of cert lot data.

rules.title: Process qualification
rules.text: Special processes shall be performed by qualified personnel using qualified procedures; qualification records shall be traceable to the operation executed.

rules.title: Inspection hold points
rules.text: Critical inspection hold points shall not be bypassed; sign-off by a qualified inspector is required before the downstream operation may start.
